description:
Ask the Financial Advisor about using TaxSort.

The question goes to Anthropic's Claude with a summary of the session's
classified totals.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

history.description: Earlier turns as a JSON array string of {"role": "user"|"assistant", "text": "..."}; the last 6 are used. Empty for a new conversation.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

session_id.description: TaxSort session id whose classified totals ground the answer; empty for none.

name: taxsort_ask_advisor
title: Ask the financial advisor
